items.basis: Corona-discharge electrostatic precipitation is a gas-phase ionization process; it cannot occur inside a water-filled 150 mm pipe. Corona onset requires dielectric breakdown of the carrier medium (air breaks down at ~30 kV/cm), whereas liquid water has a breakdown strength orders of magnitude higher and, being conductive as the candidate itself specifies, would short the 50 kV field through continuous leakage current between corona wire and plates rather than forming ions. No corona means no particle charging, so the claimed 95% collection has no physical basis in the stated medium. GROUNDED_I
